status: original-content expectation independently recorded; bounded fork runtime acceptance in linked receipt
independent_expectation: The winning original item script admits OnEquip only for the Player.
The script displays its slips-off message, stores GetContainer in its reference local, then asks that actor to unequip the actual Amulet of Kings.
The item remains carried; it is not removed or consumed.
implementation_decisions: The item is the script self/instance; the containing Player is the event action reference and GetContainer result.
Per-item locals and identity survive save/restart. Loading equipment does not constitute a new equip attempt.
An ordinary repeated equip attempt executes the same original script using the same item identity.
limits: This record/script audit is independent of production C++; it is not a native executable instruction trace or original-game live probe.
This bounded course admits a unique actually carried Player quest item. Arbitrary stacked scripted items, transfer/drop semantics and general inventory events remain open.
